title: Senior Cloud Architect
description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.


**Your Role**
-------------


We are looking for an experienced Senior Cloud Architect to lead enterprise\-scale cloud initiatives. This role involves designing secure, scalable, and cost\-optimized solutions on AWS, driving cloud adoption strategies, and mentoring technical teams. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in AWS services, automation, and governance, along with leadership experience in large transformation projects.
  

  

Key Responsibilities:  

  



* Define cloud architecture strategy aligned with business objectives and compliance requirements.
* Lead end\-to\-end design and implementation of AWS\-based solutions for complex workloads.
* Drive migration, modernization, and optimization initiatives for applications and data platforms.
* Establish cloud governance, security frameworks, and best practices using IAM, KMS, and Vault.
* Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform for multi\-environment deployments.
* Architect big data solutions leveraging EMR clusters and EMR Serverless.
* Optimize cloud costs through advanced strategies (rightsizing, reserved instances, tagging policies).
* Oversee CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins and Git for automated deployments.
* Provide technical leadership, mentor teams, and collaborate with stakeholders on cloud roadmaps.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend adoption for containerization (Docker) and serverless architectures.
**Your Profile**
----------------


* 9\+ years (with at least 6\+ years in cloud architecture and AWS)
* AWS (EC2, S3, EMR, IAM, KMS, VPC, Lambda)
* EMR (Cluster and Serverless)
* Terraform (IaC)
* Jenkins, Git (CI/CD)
* Security and compliance (IAM, KMS)
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to define cloud adoption frameworks and governance models.

Experience in leading cross\-functional teams and mentoring engineers.  
* 
**What you'll love about working here**
---------------------------------------


* You can shape your career with us. We offer a range of career paths and internal opportunities within Capgemini group. You will also get personalized career guidance from our leaders.
* You will get comprehensive wellness benefits including health checks, telemedicine, insurance with top\-ups, elder care, partner coverage or new parent support via flexible work.
* At Capgemini, you can work on cutting\-edge projects in tech and engineering with industry leaders or create solutions to overcome societal and environmental challenges.
Capgemini is an AI\-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end\-to\-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22\.1 billion.
  

Make it real \| www.capgemini.com

title: Cloud Engineer Azure
description:
We are seeking a skilled Cloud Engineer with strong Microsoft Azure and System Administration experience to manage, maintain, and optimize our cloud infrastructure for AI enabled software application. The ideal candidate should have hands\-on expertise in Azure AI app services, Windows Server administration, Active Directory, networking, virtualization, and cloud security. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring high availability, security, performance, and operational excellence of Azure\-based infrastructure.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage, monitor, and maintain Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure for AI applications
* Deploy and maintain AI/ML enabled solutions in Azure for all stages of SDLC
* Deploy, configure, and administer Azure resources including:
* Implement identity and access management using Microsoft Entra ID (Azure Active Directory).
* Configure and maintain Azure Virtual Networks, VPN Gateway, Private Endpoints, and network security.
* Azure Virtual Machines (Windows/Linux)
* Azure Virtual Network (VNet)
* Network Security Groups (NSG)
* Azure Load Balancer
* Azure Storage Accounts
* Azure Backup
* Azure Site Recovery
* Azure Monitor
* Administer Windows Server environments and perform server installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, and troubleshooting.
* Manage Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, IIS, and File Servers.
* Monitor system performance and proactively resolve infrastructure issues.
* Perform backup, disaster recovery planning, and business continuity management.
* Implement cloud security best practices, including role\-based access control (RBAC), security policies, and compliance standards.
* Manage storage, compute, and networking resources while optimizing performance and cost.
* Automate routine administrative tasks using PowerShell.
* Work closely with application, development, and security teams during deployments and infrastructure changes.
* Prepare technical documentation, SOPs, architecture diagrams, and operational runbooks.
* Participate in incident management, root cause analysis, and problem resolution.
* Manage on premise IT infra and hardware support with vendor support

**Required Skills**

**Microsoft Azure**

* Hands\-on experience managing Azure infrastructure.
* Azure services pertinent to AI/ML
* Network Security Groups (NSG)
* Azure Load Balancer
* Azure Storage Accounts
* Azure Backup
* Azure Site Recovery
* Azure Monitor
* Log Analytics
* Azure Key Vault
* Azure Bastion
* Azure Update Manager
* Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD)
* Azure RBAC
* Resource Groups
* Azure Portal
* Cost Management and Monitoring

**System Administration**

* Windows Server Administration (2016/2019/2022\)
* Active Directory
* Group Policy
* DNS
* DHCP
* IIS
* File \& Print Services
* Windows Patch Management
* Hyper\-V virtualization
* Server Monitoring and Performance Tuning

**Scripting \& Automation**

* PowerShell scripting
* Task automation
* Basic infrastructure automation

**Networking**

* TCP/IP
* Routing and Switching fundamentals
* VPN
* Firewalls
* SSL Certificates
* Network Troubleshooting

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Microsoft Azure certifications such as:
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ\-104\)
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (Preferred)
* Experience creating technical documentation and SOPs.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* Strong experience in Microsoft Azure cloud administration.
* Excellent system administration knowledge.
* Experience in managing production Azure environments.
* Ability to work independently and handle critical infrastructure.
* Strong troubleshooting and incident management skills.
* Good understanding of cloud security and compliance best practices.
* Willingness to learn new Azure technologies and continuously improve infrastructure operations.

**Why Join Us**

* Opportunity to work on enterprise\-grade Azure cloud infrastructure.
* Exposure to modern cloud technologies and automation.
* Collaborative and growth\-oriented work environment.
* Career advancement and continuous learning opportunities.

Pay: ₹500,000\.00 \- ₹1,000,000\.00 per year

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* Strong experience in Microsoft Azure cloud administration: 6 years (Required)

Location:

* Selaiyur, Chennai, Tamil Nadu (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Data Architect
description:
**Position:** Data \& AI Architect  

**Location:** KSA (Onsite)  

**Duration:** 1 Year  

**Preferred Languages:** English; Arabic is a plus

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Design enterprise data architectures including data modeling, data warehousing, and master data management.
* Design AI/ML systems in production environments.
* Develop and manage cloud data platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP) and modern data stack architectures including data lakes, lakehouse, ETL/ELT pipelines.
* Design and oversee AI/ML lifecycle activities including model selection, MLOps, deployment, and monitoring.
* Architect LLM/GenAI solutions including RAG pipelines, vector databases, prompt engineering, and model orchestration.
* Translate business requirements into technical architecture.
* Communicate effectively with engineering teams and executive stakeholders.
* Design APIs and system integrations for interconnected platforms and systems.
* Ensure alignment with data governance and compliance frameworks.
* Support smart\-city, government, and enterprise platform initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and integrated systems.

**Must Have Skills**
--------------------

### **Experience**

* 8\+ years in data architecture, with 2–3\+ years designing AI/ML systems in production.
* Strong hands\-on experience with cloud data platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP) and modern data stack (data lakes, lakehouse, ETL/ELT pipelines).
* Proven experience designing enterprise data architectures (data modeling, data warehousing, master data management).
* Solid understanding of AI/ML lifecycle: model selection, MLOps, deployment, monitoring.
* Experience with LLM/GenAI architecture (RAG pipelines, vector databases, prompt engineering, model orchestration).
* Experience with data governance and compliance frameworks.
* Ability to translate business requirements into technical architecture and communicate with both engineering teams and executive stakeholders.
* Experience with API design and system integration.

### **Technical Skills**

* Data Engineering and Data Architectures – Moderate to Advanced.
* AI Engineering – Basic to Intermediate.
* Strong SQL.
* At least one programming language (Python most common).

**Good to Have Skills**
-----------------------

### **Domain \& Compliance**

* Direct experience with PDPL, NCA ECC, or NDMO frameworks, or similar.
* GDPR/HIPAA experience.

### **Architecture \& Technologies**

* AI Advanced Architectures.
* Familiarity with real\-time/streaming data architectures (Kafka, event\-driven systems).
* Experience with IoT data ingestion (parking sensors, city infrastructure, etc.).
* Enterprise architecture certifications (TOGAF, cloud architect certifications).

### **Industry Experience**

* Experience in government, smart city, or public\-sector platforms.
* Vendor/multi\-stakeholder environment experience (JV, consortium, or large enterprise with multiple business units).

### **Language Skills**

* English (Preferred).
* Arabic language skills are a plus.

title: Support Engineer (SQL, Power BI, Java/ Javascript/ Python, Azure, Unix)
description:
**Job Description**  

Provide production support for applications by monitoring incidents, performing analysis, and resolving issues with moderate independence.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Analyze production incidents and document the resolutions applied:
* Investigates and analyzes verbal and written production incidents, understanding the issue inside highly complex applications.
* Document incidents and their resolution, facilitating further resolutions.
* Interact with final users in the day\-to\-day support work:
* Interact with different users and read between the lines to facilitate the incidents analysis.
* Contributes to the planning for application maintenance removing bugs
* Attend incident management (IM) calls to follow production issues and report status from the IT side:
* Attend IM calls to follow incidents evolution guiding the team to reach the resolution of the incident through final solution or work around.
* Report IT status regarding the incident, defining next steps
* Execute root cause analysis (RCA) to identify root causes and final resolutions to production incidents:
* Investigate application incidents for missing or incorrect functionality.
* Assesses incident resolution and estimates application changes.
* Applies resolutions, leading to timely, error\-free revisions in applications.

* Budget Responsibility: None
* Key interface relationships (internal and external): Internal: Team Leads, Client Service Managers, Communications Team, Scrum Masters.

* Other factors indicating size/complexity of role: Must be able to juggle multiple priorities and handle work requests with a sense of urgency.
